rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: Citing Articles 83 and 117 of the Constitution, Decree No. 1012 of 9 August 1999, titled 'On the Chairman of the Government', announces the dismissal ('Объявляю об отставке') of the Government of the Russian Federation; it enters into force on signature and is signed 'Президент Российской Федерации Б.Ельцин', Moscow, Kremlin, 9 August 1999, No. 1012.

rows.role_title: Исполняющий обязанности Председателя Правительства — Acting Chairman of the Government
rows.text: Point 2 entrusts the temporary performance of the duties of the Chairman of the Government to the First Deputy Chairman of the Government, Putin Vladimir Vladimirovich (printed in the accusative).

rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: Point 3 asks the members of the Government to continue performing their duties until a new Government is formed.
